name: Berry Forest Rescue & Jasmine's Duel
summary: Step into the verdant canopy of Berry Forest. Meet Gym Leader Jasmine, who asks for your help to locate her missing nephew and his playmates lost in the woodland maze. Forage across berry bushes to harvest daily damage-reducing berries (Babiri, Chople, Shuca, Yache, Haban) and pick up TM85 Dream Eater. Locate the stranded children and confront a mischievous Level 55 static Zoroark posing as an imposter child. Defeat the illusionist, retrieve the Baneful Fox Mask from the abandoned vehicle, and return to Bond Bridge. Challenge Jasmine to a 5 vs 5 duel to win the Mineral Badge, Magnemite Hairclips, and a gift Level 30 Mareanie that scares away the Brine Road Corsola barrier.

items.name: Mineral Badge
items.method: Awarded by Gym Leader Jasmine upon defeating her Steel team on Bond Bridge

items.name: Mareanie
items.method: Gifted by Jasmine at Level 30; scares away the Brine Road Corsola to open the Water Labyrinth

items.name: Magnemite Hairclips
items.method: Vanity hat awarded by Jasmine upon victory

items.name: Baneful Fox Mask
items.method: Found inside the vehicle in the forest clearing

items.name: TM85 Dream Eater
items.method: Resting on the table in the forest clearing

Static.notes: Static encounter disguised as an imposter child in Berry Forest. Illusion ability.
